thread_text:
deploy-bot: :rocket: Deploy finished — service=gateway image=redwood/gateway:v2026.3 env=prod at 2026-07-12T16:12:23Z. No automated post-deploy health checks failed.
Rae (sre-oncall): I’m seeing p99 jump from ~420ms to ~3.2s starting at 16:13 UTC, lots of 502/504 and upstream timeouts. Paging in progress. :rotating_light:
Marcus (eng-runtime): Confirmed on our side — traces show long tail during multiplex route /v1/generate. Increase in blocked worker threads and queue depth.
Rae (sre-oncall): Graphs: p50 110ms p95 680ms p99 3.2s. Error rate 5xx from 0.2% -> 6.8%.
Priya (product-support): Any customer-facing outages? Any active incidents reported?
Rae (sre-oncall): No direct tickets yet, but health check failures triggered LB retries. A few requests hit our gateway timeout 30s and returned 502.
Marcus (eng-runtime): Quick dump from the gateway logs (snip):
```
2026-07-12T16:13:05Z gateway: req_id=abc123 route=/v1/generate seq_len=350 status=timeout backend=runtime-43 wait_ms=3120
2026-07-12T16:13:06Z gateway: req_id=def456 route=/v1/generate seq_len=1200 status=502 backend=runtime-21 wait_ms=3018
```
Rae (sre-oncall): That seq_len=1200 spike looks suspicious — maybe a batching/kv cache miss regression in v2026.3. Marcus, did the runtime change batching heuristics in this roll?
Marcus (eng-runtime): We shipped a change that tweaked continuous batching thresholds and the multiplexer fallback when memory pressure is detected. Could increase end-to-end latency for certain long examples.
Ken (oncall-manager): If this is deploy-related and causing customer impact, we should rollback to v2026.2. Is a rollback safe now?
Marcus (eng-runtime): I think so — we haven't finished ramping canary to 100% but deploy-bot shows completion. We'll need a coordinated rollback to avoid split traffic.
Rae (sre-oncall): Impact assessment: ~13% of production requests see >1s additional latency; error budget burn accelerating. Recommendation: rollback and open an incident for postmortem.
Priya (product-support): I'll draft a quick customer-facing blurb once we know rollback timing.
Marcus (eng-runtime): Rolling back now. Command: `./deployctl rollback gateway --to v2026.2 --reason "p99 spike post-deploy"`
ops-bot: Executing rollback: gateway -> v2026.2. ETA: ~2m.
Rae (sre-oncall): K8s events show new pods for v2026.2 coming up. LB draining unhealthy pods.
deploy-bot: Rollback completed at 2026-07-12T16:15:40Z. Canary traffic switched back to v2026.2.
Marcus (eng-runtime): Metrics recovering — p99 down to 540ms within 90s of rollback. Error rate back to baseline.
Ken (oncall-manager): Good. Keep this thread for the postmortem. Please add timeline and any notes about root cause hypothesis.
Rae (sre-oncall): Creating incident ticket INC-2026-0712-01. Initial severity: SEV2 due to customer-impacting error rate spike.
Priya (product-support): Initial customer message (draft): "We briefly experienced elevated timeouts and 5xx responses after a deploy. We rolled back the release and metrics have returned to normal. We're investigating the root cause and will follow up." Approve?
Ken (oncall-manager): Approve. Send once incident page is up.
Marcus (eng-runtime): Quick root-cause notes: change to multiplex batching + memory-pressure fallback exposed an edge-case where long sequences bypassed KV prefix cache and caused heavy backend work, increasing queueing. The change altered timeout backoff thresholds. Need reproducer.
Rae (sre-oncall): Action items: (1) Block re-release of v2026.3 until fix + e2e tests. (2) Add synthetic traffic with long sequences to canary tests. (3) Add alert for sudden p99 > 1.5s within 5m after deploy.
Priya (product-support): I'll update the incident page and notify customers.
Marcus (eng-runtime): I'll put up a revert-fix branch and work with QE on a reproducer.
Rae (sre-oncall): Handoff to post-incident team: Marcus + Priya + Ken. Oncall rotation: Rae remains primary until 18:00 UTC.
Ken (oncall-manager): Thanks team. Marking this thread as monitored. Please add any logs/traces to the incident ticket. :white_check_mark:
Priya (product-support): Sending out customer message now.
Rae (sre-oncall): Final note: no further mitigations required; rollback resolved the immediate impact. We'll reconvene for the postmortem in 24h.
